subject: Assurance Integration Pricing & Escalation Playbook
messages:
From: Daniel Park <daniel@olivesys.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-09T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Exploring assurances for integration (uptime + escalation)

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — feature set looks promising. Before we budget for Q3, Procurement and Engineering asked for a consolidated SLA package that covers:
- 99.9% uptime for inference endpoints with regional failover
- 95th pct request latency guarantee (p90 is fine too) for bursts up to 1M tokens/day
- 24/7 escalation coverage with a named on-call contact and a 2-hour response SLA for Sev1
- Evidence needed for SOC2 + audit logging export cadence

Can you send pricing for a 12-month committed plan (expected first-year usage ~ $180k), and outline any discounts for multi-year/annual prepay? Procurement will need a short SOW and a line-item breakdown for approval.

Appreciate a clear breakdown (what's included/excluded), and let me know the fastest way to get a legal redline reviewed.

Best,
Daniel
Procurement Manager
Olive Systems

From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@olivesys.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-09T13:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring assurances for integration (uptime + escalation)

Hi Daniel — great to hear (and glad the demo landed). Attached is a pricing sheet and an initial SOW draft that maps to the items you listed. High-level options:

- Standard: best-effort regional routing, 99.5% uptime, business-hours support (M-F) — baseline pricing
- Assured: 99.9% uptime SLA, automated cross-region failover, 24/7 escalation phone + email, 4-hour Sev1 response, includes audit-log export 30-day retention — +20% premium over baseline
- Assured+: 99.95% uptime, guaranteed p95 latency cap for defined endpoints, named on-call escalation + quarterly joint runbook review, 2-hour Sev1 response, includes audited retention and SOC2 evidence package — +40% premium over baseline

For a 12-month committed spend of ~$180k we typically offer a volume-based discount (sliding scale). We can also do an annual prepay credit that bumps the effective discount.

A couple of quick notes:
- Latency guarantees are scoped to declared endpoint configs (sequence length, concurrency); we will need a short performance profile to lock the p95 target.
- The 2-hour Sev1 response is available in Assured+; Assured is 4-hour.

I've cc'd Laura (VP Customer Success) to help scope the runbook and onboarding credits. If you want, we can lock pricing into a term sheet and fast-track legal review via our standard procurement playbook (DocuSign link included).

Next step: a 30-minute call to agree a performance profile and any procurement requirements. Are you available tomorrow at 10am PT?

Regards,
Ava Chen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Assurance_Pricing_Sheet.xlsx, SOW-draft-v1.pdf

From: Daniel Park <daniel@olivesys.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exploring assurances for integration (uptime + escalation)

Ava — thanks for the options. Two asks from Procurement + Finance before we move to legal:

1) We would need Assured+ features (2-hour Sev1, p95 latency) — Olive's product SLAs require that level. Can you confirm you can guarantee p95 for our profile (mostly short requests, occasional 30k-token summaries)?
2) Pricing: with our expected $180k commit, Finance is asking for a 20% discount and a $10k onboarding credit (to cover integration engineering).

Also our procurement team needs a statement of liability and an expedited redline turn (we can provide a one-week window for legal). Do you have a playbook for on-call contact SLAs (e.g., named engineer escalation roster)?

If you can get us a revised term sheet by EOD tomorrow we can put this on the May 15 procurement board.

Thanks,
Daniel

From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T10:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Olive Systems — 20% discount request + onboarding credit (need approval)

Team — forwarding Olive's counter. Key asks: Assured+ SLA (2-hour Sev1; p95 latency for mixed short/long requests), 20% discount on $180k ARR, and $10k one-time onboarding credit. Procurement timeline: want a term sheet by EOD tomorrow to make the May 15 board.

My read: Olive is a strong logos target (enterprise productivity) and could expand quickly. If we can confirm p95 for their declared profile (we'll need to run a short perf validation) I think we can be flexible on onboarding credits. Suggest options:
A) Approve 15% discount + $7k onboarding credit; require a 3-month performance pilot to validate p95.
B) Approve 12% discount + $10k onboarding credit; no pilot (faster procurement) but require higher SLA collar and explicit fallback model in SOW.

We also should lock the Assured+ terms to a 12-month committed spend with an option to renegotiate on renewal. Thoughts?

— Ava

From: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T13:55:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Olive Systems — 20% discount request + onboarding credit (need approval)

Ava — I prefer option B with one tweak. Approve 12% discount + $10k onboarding credit, but add a 90-day SLA collar: if p95 misses by >25% on three non-consecutive weeks, we grant a tiered credit schedule and an automatic remediation plan (runbook + prioritized infra changes). That gives us protection while keeping procurement moving.

Also approve the named on-call escalation roster (we will provide an SRE contact and a secondary manager). Legal can accept expedited redlines on the SOW if Procurement agrees to our standard liability cap; if they need higher caps we should route to finance for offsetting commercial concessions.

Please prepare the term sheet and SOW with those points and include DocuSign link. I will send a brief exec note to confirm the concession.

— Karthik
Head of Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOW-draft-v1.pdf (internal)

From: Ava Chen <ava@redwood.com>
To: Daniel Park <daniel@olivesys.com>, Olive Systems Procurement <procurement@olivesys.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-12T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Final offer: Assured+ package (pricing & next steps)

Hi Daniel — thanks for the quick turnaround. Following internal review we can do the following for Olive Systems: 

Summary of final commercial:
- Assured+ package (99.95% uptime, p95 latency target scoped to declared endpoints, cross-region failover, named on-call escalation)
- 12% contract discount on the 12-month committed spend (~$158,400 net on $180k list)
- $10,000 one-time onboarding credit applied to first invoice
- 90-day SLA collar: if p95 misses by >25% in 3 non-consecutive weeks, we provide tiered service credits and a funded remediation plan (details in SOW)

Deliverables we will share with Procurement: updated SOW (attached), term sheet, and a DocuSign envelope for signatures. Technical next step: Laura will run a 2-week perf validation with your engineering team to confirm the p95 profile; if validated, we will enable the Assured+ targets on day one.

Legal: our standard liability cap applies; if Procurement needs a higher cap, please flag now so we can route to Finance. 

If acceptable, please sign the DocuSign link and we'll target a May 20 start for onboarding.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/some-doc-link-id
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/OLIVE-2026-ASR-1

Best,
Ava Chen
